steps.say: This week one new engine claimed over a thousand tokens a second on a six gigabyte laptop. Another app claimed a hundred and twenty-five billion parameters on a twelve gigabyte card.

scenes.headline: Two local speed claims, held to the bandwidth
scenes.sub: Read from the code, the headers and the catalog
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Tachyon. Both claims are real. Both lost their conditions on the way to the post.

params.slab: 1.10 GB of weights, read once per pass
lanes: Plain decoding: one token a pass
A first edit: guesses copied from the prompt
A repeated edit: the index holds the answer

steps.say: The model is one point one gigabytes. Plain decoding reads it once for every token.
An edit is mostly the prompt again, so a drafter copies guesses from it, and one pass checks them all.
Run the same edit again, and Kinetic's draft index already holds the answer. Up to nine tokens a pass.
steps.term: Draft index: every token earlier requests saw

steps.say: That is how one stream gets past the ceiling. About five tokens for every read.

scenes.quote: The edit numbers on this page are for a repeated edit.
scenes.say: The edit numbers on this page are for a repeated edit.

steps.caption: Drafted tokens arrive in bursts
steps.say: For new text, Kinetic and llama.cpp read the same bytes at the same speed. The win is for agents that resend the same files.

steps.say: Linger's figure says the two bit file is thirty-nine gigabytes.

steps.caption: Experts in RAM and on the SSD
steps.say: That is one of two shards. The second is a twenty-nine gigabyte n-gram table.
A twelve gigabyte card holds about one expert in six.
All of them wait in RAM, and the CPU computes the misses at the same time.
steps.term: Expert: one of 512 small networks per layer

steps.say: The SSD holds the lookup table, read a few rows a token. So the claim needs sixty-four gigabytes of RAM.

recap: Bandwidth over bytes sets the ceiling
Kinetic: a repeated edit, about 5.2 per pass
Linger: experts in RAM, not the SSD
scenes.say: Bandwidth sets the ceiling, drafts beat it for one stream, and RAM carries the big model. Thanks for watching!
